ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 30:70 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity contiguous region covering the left lobe and medial right lobe; distinct high-intensity (white) patch located on the distal portion of the right lobe containing internal low-intensity circular spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 115 degrees and moderate depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge; peak-to-valley amplitude is most pronounced on the distal edges, particularly near the right lobe tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the distal lobe boundaries transitioning to a concave trajectory leading into the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct low-intensity circular pixel clusters localized within the white high-intensity region on the distal right lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-intensity diagonal linear streaks (rake marks) visible on the mid-section of the low-intensity left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive dark, textured, bulbous masses consistent with barnacle colonization present on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
